name: samatva
description: Stay steady in a hard conversation. Say you're angry or need to vent, and vent replies only with short reflections of your own words, with no advice, no options, and no labels for anyone, until you're calmer. Ask for an angry message, and before-you-send holds it until tomorrow; if you insist, it only cuts from your own text and marks every cut. A skill cannot enforce its rules; the evals in the samatva repo measure whether your host model holds them.
